en: \[VSCode] Added prompt suggestions wherever the terminal shows them: Tab accepts the suggested next prompt; `promptSuggestionEnabled: false` in Claude Code's settings.json turns them off
zh: \[VSCode] 在终端显示 prompt 建议的位置新增 prompt 建议：按 Tab 接受建议的下一个 prompt；在 Claude Code 的 settings.json 中设置 `promptSuggestionEnabled: false` 可关闭
